text: Do you know that Mahishasura changed forms again and again in the war with Ammavaru?
Today, Kanakadurgamma gives darshan as Sri Mahishasuramardini Devi on Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada.
In Devi Mahatmyam, there is an interesting episode related to this war.
As soon as Ammavaru bound him with a noose, Mahishasura abandoned the buffalo form and transformed into a lion.
Then as a man holding a sword…
After that as an elephant…
Finally, he returned to the buffalo form.
He continued to attack in every form.
But Ammavaru confronted every form and finally slew him.
Because she is the mother who slew Mahishasura… she is named “Mahishasuramardini”.
There is one thing to note in this story…
His form changed.
But the tyranny that tormented the worlds did not change.
That is why this episode need not be seen merely as a victory over a demon.
No matter in how many forms it appears…
Ammavaru can be remembered as the power that confronts unrighteousness.
To the tyranny that changed forms…
The mother who put an end — Mahishasuramardini.
Om Sri Mahishasuramardinyai Namah ॥
Pocket Panchangam · Sanatana Gnanam
